response.sql: WITH transaction_sentiment AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) as avg_short_int, AVG(s.optvolrt) as avg_opt_vol FROM transactionrecord t INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), ordertype_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_short_int) as ordertype_avg_short_int FROM transaction_sentiment GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ts.transreg, ts.ordertypedist, ts.avg_short_int, ts.avg_opt_vol, CASE WHEN ts.avg_short_int IS NOT NULL AND oa.ordertype_avg_short_int IS NOT NULL AND oa.ordertype_avg_short_int != 0 THEN ts.avg_short_int / oa.ordertype_avg_short_int ELSE NULL END as short_int_ratio FROM transaction_sentiment ts INNER JOIN ordertype_avg oa ON ts.ordertypedist = oa.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_int_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
